svg.text: Original L_dynamic — a hat that moves: the particle borrows and returns energy (slingshot)
L_dynamic = L_standard + ∫ J_red · d(J_blue)/dt dλ (wiki 51, 2026-06-12): a time-dependent background. The hat drifts at u = 0.25; the energy changes by dE = ∫ ∂V/∂t dt (identity to 1e-11).
the brim at t = 0; faint gold: the brim at t = T/2 and t = T (the hat has moved)
path coloured by ΔE: blue = energy given up to the field
red = energy gained from the moving field
z of the path is the potential energy V(q − ut, t) at each time
